sections.name: Legal and administrative
sections.description: Company identity, the scope of the File, letters of good standing, construction notifications, contractor agreements and the dated legal register.

sections.name: Policy, organisation and appointments
sections.description: The health and safety policy, chief executive responsibility, the section 16(2) assignment, representatives, the committee and every statutory appointment.

sections.name: Risk management
sections.description: Baseline, issue based and task based risk assessments, the hazard register, the hierarchy of control, safe work procedures and activity plans.

sections.name: Training and competence
sections.description: Training needs, the training matrix, inductions, statutory training records, licences and competency assessments.

sections.name: Medical surveillance and fitness
sections.description: The Medical Surveillance Plan, certificates of fitness, statutory examinations and the handling of medical records. Signed by the occupational medical practitioner only.

sections.name: Registers and inspections
sections.description: Registers of equipment, installations and workplaces, with their inspection records.

sections.name: Permits and controls
sections.description: The permit to work system and the permits issued for high risk work.

sections.name: Emergency preparedness
sections.description: Emergency plans, drills, fire arrangements, medical emergency arrangements and spill response.

sections.name: Incident management
sections.description: Incident reporting, the incident register, investigations, COIDA records and corrective actions.

sections.name: Occupational hygiene
sections.description: Occupational hygiene surveys and exposure monitoring.

sections.name: Contractors, visitors and the public
sections.description: Contractor selection and control, visitor control and the protection of the public.

sections.name: Communication and consultation
sections.description: Committee minutes, representative inspections, toolbox talks, notices and change notifications.

sections.name: Environment, welfare and facilities
sections.description: Welfare facilities, the physical environment, environmental management and waste.

sections.name: Audit, review and improvement
sections.description: Internal and external audits, management review, objectives and corrective actions.

sections.name: Records and retention
sections.description: The retention schedule, storage and access control, and the POPIA operator agreement.

Machinery that needs guarding and supervision

Pressure equipment

Heat or cold exposure
